international.title: Badenoch says using amputee athletes to justify cutting disability benefits was ‘message of hope’ – UK politics live
international.summary: PM has asked Badenoch to withdraw her suggestion that benefits should be cut because ‘double amputees run marathons’ BAE Systems has announced plans to cut more than 1,000 jobs from its workforce, triggering calls for ministers to place extra orders with Britain’s biggest defence contractor , Lauren Almeida and Jasper Jolly report. Alexandra Topping is a Guardian political correspondent. There are three world leaders who look like they’re trying to carve up the world between them, a tri-polar world where Xi gets Asia, America gets the western hemisphere and Russia gets Europe, and that is very concerning, especially seeing Donald Trump call President Putin his friend. Russia is not America’s friend, it certainly hasn’t been during my lifetime. But also at a time when we’re all worried about where the Ukraine war is going, the message that is sending to President Zelensky and of course the other summit that is taking place … is very concerning indeed. The thing that we need to do is continue to stand squarely by Ukraine and that is what this government will do. And on this issue, I do pay tribute to all sides of the house because that is what we’ve managed to do in the years since the conflict began and that is the right thing to do … Let that clear message go out as that meeting takes place in [China] – this country is squarely with Ukraine.
